record.question: What is the primary advantage of MRI over CT?
options: Better imaging of soft tissues without radiation
record.explanation: Answer B: Better imaging of soft tissues without radiation. MRI provides strong soft-tissue contrast without ionizing radiation, unlike CT. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
